about: Painted backdrops for the windows that had none (2026-09-30). Higgsfield gpt_image_2_5, variant flare, quality medium, 1k, 0.5 credit each. Style references: the existing venue pictures uploaded as image_references (settings 0e629f5c, ench 29d9a30c, bank 3e4965d6, casino ad3fab35, mine 5f7f6c22). Shared prompt: 'Background painting for a menu window in a cosy medieval fantasy RPG. Match the reference images exactly in art style: detailed painterly pixel art with visible dithering and chunky pixel brushwork, rich but muted colours, soft atmospheric lighting ... No people, no characters, no animals, no text ... The main subject sits in the middle of the picture; the edges are calmer and darker ...' + one scene line each. Game copies: RGB JPEG, long side at most 1024 px, quality 86. Masters (the full generations) can be downloaded again from the job ids. The dark wash that keeps the text readable is in style.css, next to the older venue backdrops.

images.scene: the City's notice board for the nobility under a little shingled roof, parchment contracts with red wax seals, noble shields, a lantern, courtyard at dusk
an empty timber stable in the evening, stalls, straw, saddles and bridles on pegs, lanterns, an open barn door
the king's counting room: oak desk with a huge open ledger, quill, seal, gold stacks, strongbox, royal banners, arched window, city map
a pirate galleon's captain's cabin at night: chart table, compass, sextant, lantern, stern windows over a moonlit sea, a skull flag
a sellsword company's hall: trestle table with a purse of gold, a sealed contract and a dagger, weapon racks, shields, a war banner, torches
a rare-beast dealer's den: a crimson and gold dragon egg in a nest of embers on a stone plinth, chains, an empty cage, treasure
the Tides Guild's storage hall: a glowing seawater basin, pillars and torches, wave banners, glass tanks, coral and nets
the gate of the Violet Halls: violet braziers, purple banners, crystals, a war table with markers, violet mist
a frozen altar chamber: a frosted ring altar, an empty suit of ice armour floating in cold light, ice crystals, blue runes
a vaulted crypt corridor: sarcophagi in niches, ossuary shelves, candles, teal-green glow, a small chest at the far end
a casino corner with a row of brass one-armed bandits, red velvet curtains, spilled gold
a sunken shipwreck's treasure hold: open chests of gold, swords and shields among coral, light rays, a far shark silhouette
a private card room: a half-moon blackjack table, chips, a card shoe, a low brass lamp, velvet curtains
a tall casino hall: a roulette table below, a chandelier, a velvet balcony and gilded columns above
a tavern table by a rainy window: four cards face down, tankards, a candle; a stagecoach waits outside under a street lamp
two treasure chests facing each other across a long table, gold and dice between them, a candle, a crossed-swords banner
a moonlit lake from a fishing pier: a huge shark fin, a bent rod with a taut line, a lantern, pines on the far shore
a royal wardrobe: a crimson ermine-trimmed robe on a stand, a crown on a cushion, a gilded mirror, tapestries
a small farm at golden hour: thatched farmhouse, two fenced fields, hay bales, a well, rolling hills
a hall of champions: a red carpet to a dais with a golden trophy, trophies on marble pedestals, banners, empty portrait frames
